displayIdentity.body: Paul hands on the bread, cup, death, and coming. For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread. For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
displayIdentity.title: Paul hands on the bread, cup, death, and coming
